- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Core traits valued in humanistic therapists include empathy, authenticity, non-judgmental attitude, focus on the present moment, and personal growth and self-awareness.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Authenticity involves being genuine, honest, and open about experiences and feelings in therapy.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] A non-judgmental attitude means recognizing clients' rights to their own thoughts, feelings, and experiences without labels or diagnoses.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Focus on the present moment emphasizes being attuned to clients' immediate experiences and nonverbal cues.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Personal growth and self-awareness are encouraged as essential components of the therapeutic process.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Humanistic therapists create a warm, supportive, and collaborative therapeutic environment tailored to each client's unique needs.
